case_name: Subramaniya Swamy Temple v. Alikkhan Sahib & Ors. (Dargah Trustees)
parties: Temple Trustee (Plaintiff) v. Alikkhan Sahib & Ors. (Dargah Trustees & Govt)
dispute_subject: Ownership title over Thiruparankundram Hill & Giri Veedhi
arguments: Temple claimed title to whole hill. Dargah claimed title to top peak & slopes.
judicial_findings: Declared Temple owner of entire hill except 33 cents comprising Nellithope, mosque, flagstaff & steps.
final_directions: Injunction granted against Dargah encroaching beyond 33 cents.

case_name: Alikkhan Sahib & Ors. (Dargah Trustees) v. Temple Devasthanam
dispute_subject: Appeal against 1923 Sub Court title decree
arguments: Dargah contended adverse possession over top hill.
judicial_findings: Dismissed Dargah appeal; modified decree in favor of Govt cross-appeal.

case_name: Subramaniya Swamy Temple Devasthanam v. Alikkhan Sahib & Ors.
parties: Temple Trustee (Appellant) v. Alikkhan Sahib & Dargah Trustees (Respondents)
dispute_subject: Final appellate challenge to land title
arguments: Temple argued Sub Court correctly evaluated historical possession and title.
judicial_findings: Reversed High Court; fully restored 1923 Sub Court decree.
final_directions: Temple declared owner of entire hill except 33-cent Dargah enclave.

dispute_subject: Execution of 1923/1931 Privy Council decree regarding boundary demarcation
arguments: Temple sought execution of boundary demarking 33-cent enclave.

case_name: Batch Writs on Hill Naming & Animal Sacrifice (Split Verdict)
court: Madurai Bench of Madras High Court
parties: Paramasivam & Ors. v. State of TN, HR&CE, Dargah & ASI
dispute_subject: Naming of hill, animal sacrifice ban, ASI takeover
arguments: Petitioners sought ban on renaming hill to Sikkandar Malai & ban on animal sacrifice.
judicial_findings: Two-judge bench delivered split verdict on procedural enforcement.
final_directions: Matter referred to a third judge for final determination.

case_name: Batch Writs on Hill Naming & Animal Sacrifice (Final Ruling)
court: Madurai Bench of Madras High Court
parties: Paramasivam & Ors. v. State of TN, HR&CE, Dargah & ASI
dispute_subject: Final determination on hill naming and animal sacrifice
judicial_findings: 1. Affirmed official name Thiruparankundram Hill. 2. Upheld animal sacrifice ban under Rule 8 AMASR Rules. 3. Reaffirmed ASI 172.70-acre monument zone.
final_directions: Direction to ASI & Police to enforce animal sacrifice ban.

case_name: Rama Ravikumar & S. Paramasivam v. District Collector & Ors.
court: Madurai Bench of Madras High Court
parties: Rama Ravikumar & Paramasivam (Petitioners) v. Collector, HR&CE & Dargah
dispute_subject: Lighting of Karthigai Deepam at Deepathoon prior to Dec 3, 2025 festival
arguments: Petitioners sought direction to light lamp at stone pillar outside Dargah wall for Karthigai Deepam (Dec 3, 2025).
judicial_findings: Held Deepathoon lies outside Dargah 33-cent enclave on temple land.
final_directions: Directed authorities to permit lighting of Karthigai Deepam at Deepathoon on Dec 3, 2025.
decision_status: Single Bench Order (Stayed in part by SC)

case_name: State of TN / HR&CE v. Rama Ravikumar & Ors. (Division Bench Appeal)
court: Madurai Bench of Madras High Court
parties: State of TN & HR&CE (Appellants) v. Rama Ravikumar & Ors.
dispute_subject: Appeal against Single Bench Deepathoon lighting directions
arguments: State argued Single Bench order created law and order concerns.
judicial_findings: Division Bench modified Single Bench directions pending SC appeal.

case_name: State of TN / HR&CE v. S. Paramasivam, Rama Ravikumar & Ors.
parties: State of TN & HR&CE (Appellants) v. Paramasivam, Ravikumar & Ors.
dispute_subject: Challenge to High Court directions & land title observations
arguments: State argued High Court made title observations under writ jurisdiction.
judicial_findings: Supreme Court stayed High Courts observations regarding underlying land title while keeping writ pending.

case_name: State of TN / HR&CE v. Paramasivam & Ors. (Karthigai Deepam 2026 Order)
parties: State of TN & HR&CE (Appellants) v. Paramasivam & Ors.
dispute_subject: Interim prayer for Karthigai Deepam 2026 lighting
arguments: Petitioners sought one-time lighting permission for Nov 24, 2026 festival.
judicial_findings: Permitted one-time lighting of Karthigai Deepam at Deepathoon for 2026 as interim measure without prejudice to title.
final_directions: One-time interim lighting allowed for Nov 24, 2026.

case_name: State of TN Review Petition in SC
parties: State of TN (Petitioner) v. Paramasivam & Ors.
dispute_subject: Review of SC interim order dated Nov 20, 2026
arguments: State contended interim order granted main relief at interim stage.

case_name: Contempt Writs on Deepam Order Compliance
court: Madurai Bench of Madras High Court
parties: Paramasivam / Temple v. District Collector & Police
dispute_subject: Enforcement of SC order dated Nov 20, 2026
arguments: Petitioners sought direction to police to enforce SC order for Nov 24, 2026 Deepam.
judicial_findings: Directed law enforcement to facilitate compliance with SC interim order.
